whoWeAre.title: Who are we?
whoWeAre.content: GREGORIUS is a recognized manufacturer of spare parts for internal combustion engines, specializing in cylinder liners and valve seats. For decades we have delivered high-quality products tailored to individual customer needs — from single pieces to production runs.

ourGoal.title: Our Goal
ourGoal.content: We deliver products of the highest quality, continuously modernize our production processes and care for the environment. We treat every order individually, combining engineering precision with a partner-like approach to our customers.

tradition.title: Tradition
tradition.content: Our history dates back to the 1960s, when we started as a workshop for grinding cylinders and crankshafts. That is where we built the foundation of know-how we still rely on today.

development.title: Development
development.content: In 2004 we carried out a thorough restructuring, investing in quality and production efficiency. This allowed us to significantly expand our customer base in Poland and abroad — and we keep growing.

products.title: Products
products.intro: GREGORIUS is a recognized manufacturer of spare parts for internal combustion engines, specializing in high-quality cylinder liners and valve seats. Below you'll find our main product groups.

dryLiners.title: Dry Liners
dryLiners.content: We produce thin-walled dry cylinder liners with internal diameters up to 240 mm. They suit all types of internal combustion engines, compressors and lawn mowers. We also fulfill individual orders to customer specification.

wetLiners.title: Wet Liners
wetLiners.content: We offer thick-walled wet cylinder liners with internal diameters up to 240 mm, designed for all types of internal combustion engines and machinery. Also available to order, to customer requirements.

valveSeats.title: Valve Seats
valveSeats.intro: We produce valve seats in three versions, matched to the engine's operating conditions:
valveSeats.gasoline: Gasoline engines — special heat-resistant cast iron
valveSeats.gasolineLpg: Gasoline-LPG engines — cast iron developed for more demanding operation
valveSeats.diesel: Diesel engines — cast iron for particularly tough operating conditions
valveSeats.content: We produce valve seats for all types of engines. Individual orders are welcome.

services.title: Services
services.eyebrow: What we can do for you
services.intro: Beyond manufacturing, we offer full workshop support — from trading castings to regeneration and finish machining.

trade.title: Trade
trade.content: We sell castings for liners and valve seats — as tubes, castings for individual liners and shafts. We also offer MAHLE Poland products.

regeneration.title: Regeneration
regeneration.content: We offer cylinder regeneration, restoring parameters close to factory specification.

honing.title: Liner Honing
honing.content: We hone cylinder liners, ensuring the right surface finish and geometry of the working surface.

production.title: Custom Production
production.content: On individual orders, we manufacture parts from cast iron, steel and non-ferrous metals to customer requirements.

technology.title: Technology and Manufacturing Conditions
technology.intro: GREGORIUS produces its parts according to a refined technology, adapted to the technical requirements of spare parts for internal combustion engines and the high expectations of our customers.

materials.title: Materials
materials.content: Materials come from MAHLE Poland in Krotoszyn. We produce cast iron castings for cylinder liners and valve seats in accordance with the relevant industry standards.

processing.title: Processing
processing.content: Cylinder liners and other products undergo heat treatment to improve their mechanical properties. Production uses a wide range of machine tools — from universal lathes, through LSP-class automatics, to modern GILDEMEISTER CNC machines. Final precision is achieved by grinding on shaft grinders.

conservation.title: Conservation
conservation.content: All products are protected with anti-corrosion agents from Fuchs.

packaging.title: Packaging
packaging.content: Products are packed in cardboard boxes. Bulk packaging is adapted to individual customer requirements.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.content: Ordered products are shipped according to individual arrangements: by courier, mail or our own transport.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Got a question about a product, a quote or a custom order? Write or call — we'll reply quickly and to the point.
